message: The greeting must say it is an AI assistant and that this is a demo line.
Monday: Open closes before it opens.
List the postcode districts you deliver to, like NG1.
Add your drivers, so the back office can send deliveries out.
Free delivery starts at or below the minimum order, so every delivery is free.
The allergens are examples until you check them.
Burger meal: give it a price.
Chicken box: add at least one choice, like "any burger".
Pizza night: the "Pizzas" choice has nothing on the menu to choose from, so the deal is left out until you fix it.
Dear meal costs as much as its cheapest choices bought separately, so the receptionist won't suggest it as a saving.
Delivery orders need paying: take card on the phone, or let the driver take payment.
Not a UK phone number, so left off the pay-on-the-phone list: 07700 9008.
1 question needs both the question and its answer before the receptionist can use it.
